claim: Can an unchanged caller-instrumented FuzzyXAI ML observer detect externally published sklearn preprocessing anti-patterns without false alerts on correct examples, while abstaining when transform evidence is missing?

source.title: scikit-learn 1.9.1 Common pitfalls and recommended practices
source.source_type: independently authored library documentation containing deliberately incorrect and correct examples, not naturally observed production incidents

reproducers.source_behavior: Scale training features but pass unscaled test data to a fitted estimator
reproducers.deviation: Caller-instrumented equivalent of sklearn documented scalar regression example, preserving fit/transform/predict calls

reproducers.source_behavior: SelectKBest sees the entire dataset and targets prior to holdout split
reproducers.dataset: random normal features with independent random binary labels
reproducers.deviation: Regression of the documentation anti-pattern with explicitly recorded feature-selection fit IDs and supervised labels

reproducers.source_behavior: Compute scaler statistics on train+holdout, then fit estimator on train
reproducers.deviation: Specific train+holdout scaler adaptation of source's general leakage rule

scenarios.description: Published anti-pattern executed, rather than hash/metadata tampering
Valid execution while withholding the transform witness as an abstention control

comparators.observer: read-only FuzzyXAI with caller-observed fit/transform/model-output records
comparators.equal_evidence_direct: direct comparisons on the SAME actual fit input arrays, transform outputs, model fit/prediction arrays and train/eval source row IDs as available to the recorder
comparators.metadata_only: declared row-ID overlap and preprocessor-fit overlap, no value-level fitted/transform/output array comparison

decision_rules: For invalid cases, require PROBLEM in fixed_checks[id], not just any generic warning
For valid cases, count any PROBLEM among the enumerated transform-chain and split-isolation checks as false alert
For missing-transform cases, require explicit UNKNOWN for transform_trace; missing must never count as OK nor as an invalid-case detection
The direct comparator has the same inputs as the observer; do not claim superiority if tied
Prediction MSE/accuracy is descriptive, never a surrogate label for contract violations
Use exactly the listed fixed seeds, dataset configurations, and wrong/correct examples; do not adapt after observing results
Report cases descriptively and per source example; 9 observations are neither independent faults nor a population estimate
An external published anti-pattern is NOT an actual production incident; call this independent-source scenario replay, NOT blinded external validation
Caller-supplied row IDs, signing keys and model identity are not independently authenticated by this study
Out-of-scope resampling and cross-run leakage must remain unassessed, not silently certified
known_limits: Single-transform dense numeric sklearn only; the observer does not invoke model operations autonomously
No externally blinded case selection or unknown real incidents
Author-authored integrations wrap the documented scenarios and can introduce implementation bias
The study is a developer-controlled adaptation of external examples, not an independent replication of exact upstream source commits
Same-evidence direct comparator is expected to be as capable as the hash-based observer
No causal correctness or performance-superiority claim
